check_system_gcc_availability: check if system GCC is available by running gcc --version and parsing output
get_system_gcc_path: get the system GCC binary path by running which gcc in the shell
check_gcc_environment_support: check if GCC environment is supported via Docker or system GCC availability
list_available_gcc_bins: list all available GCC binaries including Docker and system GCC options
use_gcc_bin_fixture: use the gcc_bin pytest fixture to parametrize tests with available GCC binaries
